name: Business OS - Seller price snapshot daily (08:48 MSK)

nodes.name: Ozon Prices READONLY
nodes.notes: Credential required: httpCustomAuth (attach your own after import)

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT ($1::jsonb) AS j
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO raw.seller_price_obs (
    business_date, offer_id, product_id, seller_price_rub, marketing_seller_price_rub,
    old_price_rub, min_price_rub, retail_price_rub, net_price_rub, currency_code, vat,
    auto_action_enabled, auto_add_to_ozon_actions_list_enabled, ozon_actions_count,
    price_index_color, price_index_value, captured_at, source_endpoint, source_workflow_id,
    run_id, response_sha256, price_index_logic
  )
  SELECT
    (r->>'business_date')::date,
    r->>'offer_id',
    NULLIF(r->>'product_id','')::bigint,
    (r->>'seller_price_rub')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'marketing_seller_price_rub','')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'old_price_rub','')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'min_price_rub','')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'retail_price_rub','')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'net_price_rub','')::numeric,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r->>'currency_code',''),'RUB'),
    NULLIF(r->>'vat','')::numeric,
    NULLIF(r->>'auto_action_enabled','')::boolean,
    NULLIF(r->>'auto_add_to_ozon_actions_list_enabled','')::boolean,
    NULLIF(r->>'ozon_actions_count','')::integer,
    NULLIF(r->>'price_index_color',''),
    NULLIF(r->>'price_index_value','')::numeric,
    (r->>'captured_at_utc')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r->>'source_endpoint',''),'/v5/product/info/prices'),
    NULLIF(r->>'source_workflow_id',''),
    r->>'run_id',
    NULLIF(r->>'response_sha256',''),
    NULLIF(r->>'price_index_logic','')
  FROM payload, jsonb_array_elements(j->'rows') AS r
  ON CONFLICT (business_date, offer_id, run_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING offer_id
),
ins_raw AS (
  INSERT INTO landing.seller_price_raw (business_date, run_id, offer_id, product_id, color_index, commissions, marketing_actions, acquiring, raw, captured_at, source_workflow_id, response_sha256)
  SELECT (p.j->>'business_date')::date, p.j->>'run_id', x->>'offer_id', NULLIF(x->>'product_id','')::bigint, NULLIF(x->>'color_index',''),
         x->'commissions', x->'marketing_actions', NULLIF(x->>'acquiring','')::numeric, x->'raw',
         (p.j->>'captured_at_utc')::timestamptz, NULLIF(p.j->>'source_workflow_id',''), NULLIF(p.j->>'response_sha256','')
  FROM payload p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j->'raw_items') AS x
  WHERE x->>'offer_id' IN (SELECT offer_id FROM ins)
  RETURNING offer_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT j->>'business_date' FROM payload) AS business_date,
  (SELECT j->>'run_id' FROM payload) AS run_id,
  (SELECT (j->>'n_rows')::int FROM payload) AS n_rows_in,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) AS n_inserted,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins_raw) AS n_raw_inserted;
